=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2310-2313 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The command-prefix assignment `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_SKIP=true PR_FINAL_CI_SYNC_QUICK="${sync_ci_quick}" _pr_ensure_final_ci ...` inside `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci` is said to stay set after the function returns, so every later `_pr_ensure_final_ci` call in the same process fails the guard at line 1275 and skips `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). In the sweep loop (scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:340) or the review_enable_auto_merge.sh overlap path, later behind heads would then dispatch final CI on a stale `ci.yml` with no `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WIRING` line, which breaks G1/G2/G6 of #9993. `PR_FINAL_CI_SYNC_QUICK` leaks the same way, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes that this half predates the PR. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejects the finding. Its argument is that bash keeps prefix assignments on function calls only in POSIX mode, and all callers use `#!/usr/bin/env bash` without `set -o posix` or POSIXLY_CORRECT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1288-1296 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The e2e-smoke-test label probe in `_pr_ensure_final_ci` only inspects `pr_json`, which stays empty when the caller passes both a head ref and a base ref. `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (lines 1519-1521) passes both and does not set `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE` itself, so the probe is skipped there.
  WHY: An e2e-smoke-test PR that is behind on `ci.yml` can be updated during the gate (merge lease taken, branch update requested, synchronize run started) instead of being held with `no_update_path`. That is the race the opt-out in scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:183-194 exists to prevent. The source rated it NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1297-1298 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE="${final_ci_wiring_no_update}"` prefix on the `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` call is said to stay set after the call. The next `local final_ci_wiring_no_update="${PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE:-}"` at line 1292 would then read the leaked value.
  WHY: After an e2e head in a sweep tick, later non-e2e behind heads in the same process would be held check-only with `reason=no_update_path` instead of being updated. The branch update is delayed to the next tick, and the reviewer notes the failure is in the safe direction and fixes itself on the next tick. The source rated it NIT (mapped to low). The same POSIX-mode disagreement from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 applies by mechanism.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G4: The check costs no extra API call per PR per tick in the common case. Compare blob SHAs from data the caller already has, or from one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh snapshot and candidate handling; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_ensure_final_ci` and `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The sweep snapshot holds only `{number, head_ref, head_sha}` (`scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:17-19`), and candidates call `_pr_ensure_final_ci` without a base ref (`scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:340`). `_pr_ensure_final_ci` then reads the PR to get the base (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1283-1285`), and the wiring helper calls `compare/<head>...<base>` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2676-2677`). No per-cycle cache of the base's `ci.yml` blob SHA exists, so held candidates repeat these reads every tick, up to `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK` times. Merge paths reuse `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_PATHS` (pr_checks_lib.sh:1770-1771, 1850-1853) and cost 0 calls. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna, NIT from z-ai_glm-5_3-flash. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 treat this as an accepted, deferred residual, because scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh is outside files_touched and the cost is capped by FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK.
- requirement: "G5. A PR that itself changes ci.yml is not forced into an update by this rule alone."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` sets wiring_behind="yes" when `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is in the base-side commits (wiring_paths). It does not check whether the PR branch also changed that file, so a behind PR that edits ci.yml is still forced into an update. Severity: MAJOR. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state that G5 is present in the PR diff.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "G5. A PR that itself changes ci.yml is not forced into an update by this rule alone."
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update
  Evidence of absence: The logic in _pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update checks whether `.github/workflows/ci.yml` appears in the base-side commits (wiring_paths) and sets wiring_behind="yes" if it does, without checking whether the PR branch also modified that same workflow file. A PR that modifies ci.yml and is behind will still be forced into an update, violating G5.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:lines 2310-2313 (inside `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci`) interacting with the guard at line 1275 inside `_pr_ensure_final_ci` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The prefix assignment of `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_SKIP=true` and `PR_FINAL_CI_SYNC_QUICK` on the `_pr_ensure_final_ci` call is described as sticky. Neither variable is declared `local` or unset afterwards, so later `_pr_ensure_final_ci` calls in the process skip `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` and write no `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WIRING` line.
  WHY: The function is reached from `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2356`, `:2479`, `:2843` and `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:251`. The reviewer gives two paths: `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` line 335 (overlap) followed by lines 353 / 1520, and the sweep's `:340` pass. In both, later behind heads dispatch a stale `ci.yml` run, which is what #9993 was meant to prevent.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:lines 1288-1296 (the e2e-smoke-test label probe inside `_pr_ensure_final_ci`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `pr_json` is populated only by the GET at lines 1256-1258 or 1283-1285. A caller that passes both refs skips the label probe, and `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` at line 1519-1521 does not set `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE`. The new comment documents this but does not fix it.
  WHY: An e2e-smoke-test PR that is behind on `ci.yml` can be updated during the gate instead of being held with `no_update_path`, which is the race scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:183-194 guards against.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "G4: The check costs no extra API call per PR per tick in the common case. Compare blob SHAs from data the caller already has, or from one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle."
  Expected change site: `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` sweep snapshot and the wiring helper in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` (`_pr_ensure_final_ci` and `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`).
  Evidence of absence: The snapshot carries only `{number, head_ref, head_sha}` and no base ref. `_pr_ensure_final_ci` GETs the PR (`pr_checks_lib.sh:1283-1285`), and `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` GETs the compare (`pr_checks_lib.sh:2676-2677`). There is no per-cycle cache of the base's `ci.yml` blob SHA, so held candidates repeat the reads every tick, up to `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK` times. G4 is implemented for merge paths through the `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_*` side channel but not for the sweep.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING H1: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2310-2313. Replace the bare prefix with `local` declarations. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 4
- HARDENING H2: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1519-1521. Set `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE=true` for e2e-labelled PRs, or make the helper always probe the label. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:line 2312-2313 (`PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_SKIP=true PR_FINAL_CI_SYNC_QUICK="${sync_ci_quick}" \` before the `_pr_ensure_final_ci` call inside `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci`), interacting with the guard at line 1275 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Prefix assignments before a shell-function call are said to persist after it returns. `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_SKIP` is never unset, so after the first `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci` call every later `_pr_ensure_final_ci` call skips `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` and logs no `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WIRING` line.
  WHY: The sweep (scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:317-347) loops over heads in one process. A second behind head would dispatch on a stale `ci.yml`, which G1/G2 forbid, with no decision line, which breaks G6. The same leak crosses PRs in the poller's final-merge path. The `PR_FINAL_CI_SYNC_QUICK` leak predates the PR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:line 1297-1298 (`PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE="${final_ci_wiring_no_update}" \` before the `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` call in `_pr_ensure_final_ci`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE=true` stays set after an e2e head, and line 1292 reads the leaked value on the next call.
  WHY: Later non-e2e behind heads in the same sweep tick are held with `reason=no_update_path` instead of being updated. The update is delayed to the next tick, which the reviewer calls the safe direction and says fixes itself.
